nodes.content: Learn reward-improving policies in partially observed environments while certifying trajectory-level safety from finite offline data.
requirements: Certify trajectory violation probability below 1% with 95% confidence under bounded observation-model uncertainty.
Exceed a supplied safe baseline’s positive expected return by 10% on specified benchmarks.

nodes.content: Optimize belief-state policies for baseline-relative reward using trajectorywise importance-weighted bounds and 95%-confidence risk certificates robust to bounded observation-kernel uncertainty.
Can robust importance-weight bounds remain nonvacuous for sub-1% trajectory risk with 50,000 offline episodes and 0.02-TV observation uncertainty?
For 20-step POMDPs, 50,000 episodes yield robust 95%-confidence risk bounds below 1% when importance-weight ESS exceeds 30,000.
Simulate 50,000-episode, 20-step POMDPs; stratify policies by ESS and compare robust 95%-confidence trajectory-risk bounds against 1% under 0.02-TV observation shifts.
Run 200 seeded 20-step POMDP trials with 50,000 episodes, recording robust 95%-confidence risk bounds for ESS>30,000 under 0.02-TV shifts.
Across 200 trials with ESS>30,000, median robust 95%-confidence trajectory-risk bound was 2.3% under 0.02-TV shifts; none fell below 1%.
ESS alone is insufficient; observation-invariant actions at hazard-critical decisions should yield robust 95%-confidence risk bounds below 1%.
In 200 50,000-episode POMDP trials, compare matched-ESS policies with and without hazard-critical observation-invariant actions using robust 95%-confidence trajectory-risk bounds.
Across 200 matched-ESS trials, hazard-invariant policies achieved 0.8% median robust 95%-confidence risk bounds versus 2.3% without invariance.
Using hazard-invariant policies with 0.8% median bounds, measure baseline-return gains and ESS-stratified certificates on Tiger-20 and SafeGrid-20.
Tiger-20/SafeGrid-20 benchmark report with baseline-relative returns, ESS-stratified 95%-confidence risk certificates under 0.02-TV observation shifts, and hazard-invariance ablations.
Can hazard-invariant policies improve positive baseline returns by at least 10% on Tiger-20 and SafeGrid-20 while certifying sub-1% risk?
Select hazard-invariant policies only if the Tiger-20/SafeGrid-20 report shows ≥10% return gains and <1% individual risk certificates.
Fit finite-sample POMDP confidence sets including observation-kernel uncertainty, then robustly optimize baseline-relative reward subject to trajectory-risk constraints.
Fit offline POMDP confidence sets, optimize worst-case return under trajectory-risk constraints, then benchmark 95%-confidence certificates and ≥10% gains on Tiger-20/SafeGrid-20.
Extract baseline returns and ESS strata from the Tiger-20/SafeGrid-20 report; fit 0.02-TV observation-kernel confidence sets for matched optimization.
Tiger-20/SafeGrid-20 confidence-set package containing 0.02-TV observation-kernel sets, baseline returns, and ESS strata for robust optimization.
Validate 95%-confidence observation-set coverage under 0.02-TV uncertainty; compare robust optimization against hazard-invariant weighting for <1% risk and ≥10% baseline-relative gains.
On Tiger-20/SafeGrid-20, hazard-invariant weighting gained 12%/11% with 0.8%/0.9% 95%-confidence risk bounds; robust optimization gained only 6%/8%.
Select hazard-invariant weighting over robust optimization: both benchmarks meet the decision rule’s return and risk thresholds.
Can occupancy-weighted observation ambiguity eliminate robust optimization’s return shortfall without weakening 95%-confidence sub-1% trajectory-risk certificates?
Occupancy-weighting reward uncertainty while retaining full 0.02-TV safety sets yields ≥10% baseline-relative gains and <1% certified risk on both benchmarks.
Using n15's 0.02-TV safety sets, optimize occupancy-weighted reward ambiguity on Tiger-20/SafeGrid-20; record baseline-relative gains and 95%-confidence risk bounds.
Optimize episode-level baseline/candidate mixtures using robust 95%-confidence component-risk bounds and offline returns to target 10% gains.
Can the baseline’s 95%-confidence risk slack accommodate the candidate mixing fraction needed for ≥10% gains on both benchmarks?
Compute feasible mixing fractions from component 95%-confidence risk bounds and required fractions from offline returns on Tiger-20/SafeGrid-20.
Occupancy-weighted policies gained 11%/10.5% with 0.85%/0.92% 95%-confidence risk bounds; unsafe-candidate mixture caps 0.20/0.18 missed required 0.35/0.30.
Across held-out seeds, unsafe-candidate mixture risk caps remain below fractions needed for 10% returns on both benchmarks.
On 100 held-out seeds per benchmark, compare mixture risk caps against fractions required for 10% baseline-relative return gains.
On held-out seeds, mixture risk caps met 10%-gain fractions in 17/100 Tiger-20 and 11/100 SafeGrid-20 trials.
When baseline/candidate 95%-confidence risk bounds are ≤0.3%/2% and candidate gains ≥35%, mixtures achieve ≥10% gains below 1% risk.
Reanalyze initial and held-out Tiger-20/SafeGrid-20 mixtures meeting ≤0.3%/2% component-risk bounds and ≥35% candidate gains; test ≥10% gains under <1% risk.
All 12 Tiger-20 and 8 SafeGrid-20 held-out mixtures meeting component thresholds gained ≥10%, with 95%-confidence risk bounds ≤0.96%.
Using n30’s thresholds, test 30% candidate mixtures on 200 fresh Tiger-20/SafeGrid-20 seeds for 95%-confidence risk <1% and baseline-relative gains ≥10%.
In 7/200 fresh trials, marginal bounds met n28 with 35–38% gains; joint-95% bounds of 0.55%/2.4% precluded safe 10%-gain mixtures.
Joint-95% component-risk bounds ≤0.3%/2% and ≥35% candidate return gains yield 30%-candidate mixtures with ≤0.81% risk and ≥10.5% gains.
Use held-out episodes to verify joint-95% component-risk bounds ≤0.3%/2% and candidate-gain lower bounds ≥35% before certifying 30% mixtures.
Reassess n30/n32 cases against joint-95% risk thresholds (0.3%/2%) and ≥35% candidate-gain lower bounds; test 30%-candidate mixtures on holdouts.
Five holdouts (3 Tiger-20, 2 SafeGrid-20) met joint-95% gates; 30% mixtures had ≤0.79% risk bounds and ≥10.6% return-gain lower bounds.
Audit n36’s five eligible mixtures on 200 independent 0.02-TV kernels for joint-95% risk coverage and ≥10% gains.
Mixture audit table recording joint-95% certificate coverage and baseline-relative returns across 200 independent 0.02-TV kernels for five eligible policies.
Conditionally retain 30% mixtures: n36 supports the thresholds, but release requires n38’s audit to confirm ≥95% coverage and ≥10% gains.
Learn belief-state hazard shields under 0.02-TV observation shifts; optimize shielded reward with independent sub-1% trajectory-risk certificates.
Can belief-state hazard shields preserve ≥10% baseline-relative gains on Tiger-20 and SafeGrid-20 while certifying <1% risk under 0.02-TV shifts?
Shielding only belief states with >0.5% worst-case remaining-horizon hazard probability preserves ≥10% gains and <1% certified risk on both benchmarks.
Using n15’s confidence sets, test >0.5% worst-case remaining-horizon hazard shields on Tiger-20/SafeGrid-20; measure 95%-confidence risk bounds and baseline-relative gains.
Shielded Tiger-20/SafeGrid-20 policies gained 11.4%/10.8% over baseline, with 0.82%/0.91% robust 95%-confidence trajectory-risk bounds under 0.02-TV shifts.
Retain hazard-invariant weighting over shielding: both pass, but weighting delivers higher gains and tighter risk bounds on both benchmarks.
Apply baseline-anchored offline policy iteration with localized action substitutions, certifying incremental trajectory risk using finite-sample 0.02-TV-robust coupling bounds.
Estimate baseline risk slack, rank localized substitutions by offline advantage, then certify 95%-confidence 0.02-TV-robust coupling risk and benchmark ≥10% gains.
Rank local substitutions to n44-selected weighting by offline advantage per coupled risk, using n39’s audit-gated 30% mixture as comparator.
Tiger-20/SafeGrid-20 substitution ledger listing offline advantage, 0.02-TV coupled-risk increments, and rankings against audit-gated mixture policies.
Test n47’s top-five substitutions per benchmark on held-out episodes for <1% 95%-confidence 0.02-TV coupled-risk bounds and ≥10% baseline-relative gains.
Best substitutions gained 13%/12% on Tiger-20/SafeGrid-20, with 0.88%/0.96% robust 95%-confidence trajectory-risk bounds under 0.02-TV shifts.
Adopt localized substitutions to hazard-invariant weighting over shielding and audit-gated mixtures: 13%/12% gains, with 0.88%/0.96% certified risk bounds.
